title: The base conserved energy does not control the K1378 coefficient norm

concentration.block: u_N=(2N+1)^(-1) sum_{k2,k3=-N}^N exp(i(k2 x2+k3 x3)) is a real two-dimensional Dirichlet square; v_N=(2N+1)^(-3/2) sum_{k in {-N,...,N}^3} exp(i k dot x) is a real three-dimensional Dirichlet cube
concentration.electric_data: E_N=u_N(x2,x3)e_1 is divergence-free with fixed L2 Maxwell energy and unbounded L-infinity norm
concentration.radial_data: phi_N=e_4 and pi_N=v_N e_4 are real aligned charge-4 data
concentration.radial_energy: matter momentum, mass and charge-regularizer terms are uniformly bounded
concentration.radial_derivative: for f(s)=lambda s, partial_t f(||phi||^2)=2lambda Re<phi,pi>=2lambda v_N at t=0
concentration.neutrality: Im<Qphi_N,pi_N>=0, so the Gauss density is zero
concentration.conclusion: the base Maxwell-matter energy and Gauss constraint do not bound ||E||_infinity or ||partial_t f||_infinity
